location.description: Location to search in (e.g., 'New York, NY', 'London, UK'). Required for 'search' mode.
location.title: Location

maxResults.description: Maximum number of business results to scrape. Only used in 'search' mode.
maxResults.title: Maximum Results

maxReviews.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape. Only used in 'reviews' mode.
maxReviews.title: Maximum Reviews

mode.description: Choose the scraping mode: search for businesses, or scrape reviews from a specific place.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

placeId.description: Canonical Google Place ID beginning with ChIJ. Use this instead of placeUrl in reviews mode.
placeId.title: Google Place ID

placeUrl.description: Google Maps place URL to scrape reviews from. Required for 'reviews' mode.
placeUrl.title: Place URL

proxyConfiguration.description: Select proxies to be used by this actor. Recommended for avoiding rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Using proxies is strongly recommended to avoid IP bans.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQuery.description: What to search for (e.g., 'restaurant', 'hotel', 'coffee shop'). Required for 'search' mode.
searchQuery.title: Search Query
